title: Repair checkpoint evidence for v0.0.6.68 through v0.0.6.128
summary: Track the two published repair plans and the per-issue evidence needed for review. Both plans remain in planning until implementation is approved.
acceptance_criteria: Follow the published sequence and each checkpoint's own acceptance criteria after implementation is approved.
Replay the original issue and a known-good control after each scoped repair. Record the exact repair SHA, public runner attempt and job, expected and observed outputs, and any gaps before advancing.
When issues share a fixture or fix, retain separate acceptance results and link them to the revision that actually addressed the behavior.

evidence.claim: The earlier plan records its checkpoint order and approval hold.
The follow-up plan documents the mapped issue families and the required post-fix debug gate.
